ini:
[Upscalers]
; Select upscaler for DX12 games
Dx12Upscaler=fsr31
;Dx11Upscaler=ignored
Dx11Upscaler = xess

[FSR]
Fsr4Model=1
Fsr4Update=true
Fsr4Update=false

[Tweaks]
; Overlay position
; a, b, c - Default (auto) is a
Position=b
Scale=1.5
Note=not a number

[Log]
LogLevel=2
